The '''Rattataki Battlewoods''' was a wooded area in the northern side of the [[High Security Section]] of the [[Belsavis prison]]. It included the [[Power Generation Center]], the detention complex that included the [[Republic detention compound]] and the [[Primary Monitoring Station]], the [[Republic watchtower]], and [[Vault S-86]].<ref name="TOR" />

Around [[3624 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.4}}</ref> during the [[Third Galactic War]], [[Alliance Commander|the Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]] searched the area for the [[HK-24 series assassin droid]] [[Shebs]].<ref name="TOR:TMH">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|The Memory Heist|Belsavis}}</ref>
